animations.label: Motion
animations.info: Subtle adds scroll reveals and hover transitions. Full adds motion tied to scroll position, such as rising headlines, image reveals and a parallax hero. Visitors who ask their device to reduce motion always see the static theme.

motion_style.label: Motion style
motion_style.info: Select the physical timing and interaction style across the storefront.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.info: Use a square image for the clearest browser tab icon.

show_cart_note.label: Show order note field
show_cart_note.info: Lets customers add a message to their order.

background_gradient.label: Background gradient
background_gradient.info: A gradient replaces the background color when one is set.

all.link_destination_info: Choose a store page or paste the full HTTPS address. External pages must stay publicly accessible.

button_url.label: Button link
button_url.info: The button only appears once it has a link.

show_quick_add.label: Show add to cart on product cards
show_quick_add.info: Single-variant products add in one click. Products with one size option, with or without color, show a size picker. Products with more options, subscriptions or gift cards link to the product page.

enable_country_selector.label: Show country/region selector
enable_country_selector.info: Lets customers switch currency. Appears only when the store sells to two or more countries or regions in Shopify Markets.

enable_language_selector.label: Show language selector
enable_language_selector.info: Appears only when the store has two or more published languages.

secondary_menu.label: Secondary menu
secondary_menu.info: Optional menu for documentation, support or about links. Shown beside the header actions and at the bottom of the mobile menu. Hidden when it is the same menu as the main menu.

menu_item.label: Menu item
menu_item.info: Name of the top-level menu item that opens this mega menu, for example "Catalog". Capitals don't matter, and in other languages the translated name also works. The item needs sub-links. Items with three levels of links open a mega menu even without this block.

image_1.label: Image
image_1.info: Shown in portrait, 4:5. Use an image at least 800 px wide.

image_2.label: Image
image_2.info: Shown in portrait, 4:5. Use an image at least 800 px wide.

settings.link_info: Choose a store page or paste the full HTTPS address. Without a link, the card still shows but cannot be clicked.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use heading 2 unless this section sits under another heading on the page.

posts_to_show.label: Posts to show
posts_to_show.info: Shows fewer posts when the blog has fewer than this number.

video.label: Video
video.info: Plays silently on a loop. Keep it under 10 seconds so the page stays fast.

video_poster.label: Video poster image
video_poster.info: Shown while the video loads and to visitors who prefer reduced motion.

enable_video_mobile.label: Play the video on mobile too
enable_video_mobile.info: Off by default to save your customers' data. The poster image is shown instead.

overlay_style.label: Overlay
overlay_style.info: A gradient keeps more of the image visible than a full tint.

overlay_opacity.label: Overlay strength
overlay_opacity.info: Low values can leave the text hard to read on light images. Check the result on desktop and mobile.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Automatic uses Heading 1 on the home page and Heading 2 everywhere else, so each page keeps a single top-level heading.

button_primary_url.label: Primary button link
button_primary_url.info: The button only appears once it has a link.

button_secondary_url.label: Secondary button link
button_secondary_url.info: The button only appears once it has a link.

image_alt.info: Describes the image for screen readers. Leave blank to use the image's own alternative text, or none when a heading already explains it.

tab_label.label: Tab name
tab_label.info: Leave empty to use the collection name.

editorial_image.label: Spotlight image
editorial_image.info: Shown beside the products for this tab.

media_label.label: Image label
media_label.info: A short caption printed over the image. Leave empty to hide.

image_alt.info: Describes the image for screen readers. Leave blank to use the image's own alternative text, or none when a heading already explains it.

image_ratio.label: Image shape
image_ratio.info: Choose Original to keep the image's own proportions. Other shapes crop it.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use level 1 only for the main heading of the page. Other sections should use level 2 or 3.

height_desktop.label: Minimum height on desktop
height_desktop.info: Percentage of the screen height. A slide grows taller on its own when its text needs more room.

height_mobile.label: Minimum height on mobile
height_mobile.info: Percentage of the screen height. A slide grows taller on its own when its text needs more room.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use level 1 only for the main heading of the page. Other sections should use level 2 or 3.

autoplay.label: Change slides automatically
autoplay.info: Automatic changes pause on hover and focus. For visitors who prefer reduced motion, slides never change automatically and the pause button is not shown. Otherwise a pause button is shown.

image_alt.info: Describes the image for screen readers. Leave blank to use the image's own alternative text.

overlay_opacity.label: Image overlay
overlay_opacity.info: Darkens the image so the text stays readable. Raise it for bright photos.

video.label: Video file
video.info: A video uploaded to Shopify. Takes priority over the video link below.

video_url.label: Video link
video_url.info: A YouTube or Vimeo link. The player loads from that service only after a visitor presses play.

cover_image.label: Cover image
cover_image.info: Shown before the video plays. Uploaded videos use their own preview when this is empty.

video_title.label: Video title
video_title.info: Read aloud by screen readers to describe the video. Required for accessibility.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use level 1 only for the main heading of the page. Other sections should use level 2 or 3.

image_alt.label: Image alternative text
image_alt.info: Describe the whole scene. The products are already named by their markers.

horizontal_position_mobile.label: Mobile position from the left
horizontal_position_mobile.info: Set to 0 to use the desktop position.

vertical_position_mobile.label: Mobile position from the top
vertical_position_mobile.info: Set to 0 to use the desktop position.

popover_position.label: Product card position
popover_position.info: Where the product card opens in relation to the marker.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use heading 2 unless this section sits under another heading on the page.

image.label: Custom image
image.info: Replaces the collection image. Leave empty to use the collection image or its first product.

product.label: Product
product.info: Add two to four products. Products sold only by subscription link to their own page instead.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use heading 2 unless this section sits under another heading on the page.

show_dynamic_checkout.label: Show express checkout buttons
show_dynamic_checkout.info: Shows Shop Pay, PayPal and other methods you have enabled.

intent.label: Recommendation type
intent.info: Complementary products need the free Search & Discovery app installed and set up. Without it this section stays hidden.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Leave empty to use the default heading for the recommendation type.
Leave blank to show the translated default heading. Products are stored in this browser only.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: Use heading 2 unless this section sits under another heading on the page.

text_alignment.label: Text alignment
text_alignment.info: Start and end follow the reading direction of the language.

enable_tiered_progress.label: Show free shipping and gift progress
enable_tiered_progress.info: The bar stays hidden until at least one threshold is set, and when customers shop in a currency other than the store currency.

free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping amount
free_shipping_threshold.info: Match your actual shipping rates and eligible markets in Settings > Shipping and delivery. This amount does not create a shipping rate, make express shipping free, or guarantee eligibility at checkout. Leave empty or enter 0 to skip this step and show only the gift.

atelier_gift_threshold.label: Gift amount
atelier_gift_threshold.info: Match an actual gift offer and its eligibility conditions. Configure any required products and discounts in Shopify. This amount does not add a gift or create a discount. Leave empty or enter 0 to skip this step and show only free shipping.

show_complementary_products.label: Show complementary products
show_complementary_products.info: Shows up to two eligible products when the cart has items. Products already in the cart are excluded. Choose products below to use this feature without an app.

use_product_metafield.label: Use product-specific selections
use_product_metafield.info: In Settings > Custom data > Products, define custom.complementary_products as a list of product references, then choose products on each product page in the admin. Eligible selections for the main product in the cart take priority over the sources below.

use_search_discovery.label: Use Shopify complementary recommendations
use_search_discovery.info: Optional. Uses complementary products configured in Shopify Search and Discovery after eligible product-specific selections. Products selected below are used when results are unavailable. No app installation is required for manual selections.

cross_sell_collection.label: Collection to suggest from
cross_sell_collection.info: Fills remaining spaces after eligible product-specific selections, Shopify recommendations, and products selected below. Only available products outside the cart are shown.

cross_sell_price_band.label: Prefer suggestions in a price range
cross_sell_price_band.info: Applies to Shopify recommendations and the collection. Suggestions priced within the range below, as a share of the most expensive item in the cart, are shown first. Others still fill remaining spaces. Product-specific selections and products selected below are not filtered.

product.info: Products without customer-selectable options can be added directly. Other products require an option selection or a visit to the product page. Duplicate products and products already in the cart are excluded.

enable_media_zoom.label: Enable image zoom
enable_media_zoom.info: Opens product images in a full-screen viewer with click, pinch and keyboard zoom. Zoom stops at the resolution of the uploaded file: for close-up detail, upload images at least 3000 px wide.

enable_sticky_cart.label: Show sticky add to cart bar
enable_sticky_cart.info: Appears once the customer scrolls past the add to cart button.

pickup_hours_note.label: Pickup hours note
pickup_hours_note.info: Shown with every pickup location on every product.

show_model_fit_below.label: Show the model fit note on the page too

page_content.label: Size chart page
page_content.info: Use a page when you need a real table. The measurement fields below only support plain paragraphs and lists.

show_dynamic_checkout.label: Show express checkout buttons
show_dynamic_checkout.info: Shows Shop Pay, PayPal and other methods you have enabled.

threshold.label: Low stock threshold
threshold.info: The count appears only when Shopify tracks inventory for the selected option.

delivery_text.label: Delivery message
delivery_text.info: Match your shipping rates and delivery estimates. Leave blank to hide this block.

returns_text.label: Returns message
returns_text.info: Match your published returns policy. Leave blank to hide this block.

page.label: Page
page.info: Its content appears after the text above. Use it to share one policy across many products.

material.label: Material composition
material.info: Displays fabric composition or material blend. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block.

gsm.label: Fabric weight (GSM)
gsm.info: Enter a documented fabric mass per square meter. This is not the garment or shipping weight. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block.

hardware.label: Hardware and trims
hardware.info: Add the actual manufacturer, series and finish. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block. Leave unknown details blank.

origin.label: Origin and craftsmanship
origin.info: Use documented product data. Fabric origin and manufacturing location can differ. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block.

circa_year.label: Circa year
circa_year.info: Era or estimated year of production. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block. Leave blank if unconfirmed.

show_unique_piece.label: Show unique piece label
show_unique_piece.info: Requires documented uniqueness and a reviewed single physical item. Size variants, untracked inventory or overselling make the item ineligible. This setting applies to every product that displays this block.

condition_grade.label: Condition grade
condition_grade.info: Select a grade only after inspection. Disclose damage, repairs and use restrictions separately. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block.

provenance_notes.label: Provenance notes
provenance_notes.info: Historical context, collection season or archival record notes. Shown as entered on every product that displays this block.

default_grid_columns.label: Default products per row
default_grid_columns.info: Sets the desktop default. On phones the two options render one and two products per row.

position_in_grid.label: Position in grid
position_in_grid.info: Position the tile takes in the grid. For example, 4 makes it the fourth item. Moves to the end of the grid when the collection has fewer products.

show_author.label: Show the author of the featured post

single_open_faq.label: Open one question at a time

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.info: Used in the table of contents link, for example quick-start. Leave empty to build it from the heading. Each anchor must be unique on the page.

code.label: Snippet
code.info: Shown in a monospaced block with a copy button.

sla.label: Response time badge
sla.info: Shown under the introduction. Leave empty to hide it.

single_open_faq.label: Open one answer at a time

items.label: Points
items.info: A bulleted list reads best here.

show_third_image.label: Show a third image
show_third_image.info: Turn this off for a two image mosaic.

single_open.label: Open one answer at a time
single_open.info: Opening an answer closes the others in the same category.

show_search.label: Show the instant search field
show_search.info: Filters the questions as the shopper types. Hidden when the page has fewer than two questions, or when JavaScript is unavailable.

updated_at.label: Last updated
updated_at.info: Shown under the page title. Leave empty to hide it.

show_toc.label: Show table of contents
show_toc.info: Built from the heading level 2 titles in the page content. Hidden when the page has fewer than two.

opening_note.label: Opening note
opening_note.info: A short line such as an opening date. Leave empty to hide.
